limitations: Additive development-only content, not reviewed or calibrated production questions. No changes to existing published questions.

content.prompt: A tenant-scoped payroll report uses a parameter supplied by the browser. Which approach prevents SQL injection while preserving tenant isolation?
options: Bind the value as a query parameter and obtain the tenant predicate from the authenticated server context.
Concatenate the value after removing spaces.
Trust a tenant ID received in the request body.
Remove the tenant predicate when the report returns no rows.
content.explanation: Parameterized values prevent treating user input as SQL; tenant ownership must come from the trusted authenticated context.

content.prompt: A report must list customers with no orders, including when an order row has a NULL customer reference. Which query form safely expresses the requirement?
options: Use customer_id NOT IN an unfiltered subquery that may return NULL.
Use a correlated NOT EXISTS subquery comparing each order to the current customer.
Use an INNER JOIN without a filter.
Select all customers whenever any order reference is NULL.
content.explanation: Correlated NOT EXISTS checks the absence of matching orders without the NULL ambiguity of NOT IN.

content.prompt: An integration consumer receives the same payment event twice. Which basic contract prevents the business effect being applied twice?
options: Identify the event with a stable ID and handle the effect idempotently.
Apply every delivery as a new payment.
Generate a new event ID on every retry.
content.explanation: A stable event identity and idempotent effect let delivery retries recover safely without duplicating the business operation.

content.prompt: A production-like error report includes a user's authentication token. What is an appropriate first debugging action?
options: Post the complete token to a shared issue.
Disable authorization globally until the error disappears.
Reproduce with a minimal sanitized input and correlate server logs using a non-secret request ID.
Replace the user's data before investigating.
content.explanation: A minimal sanitized reproduction and request correlation preserve diagnostic evidence without exposing credentials or altering unrelated data.
